U1 point_match needs both dates (30 April 2027 and 14 June 2027) or a gap word (before, ahead of, lapse); a bare expiry or audit word no longer passes. pass_rule: Three parts, all on output.md derived from raw.html by forum/derive.py: ruler v3.1 (score_forum.py doc <run> --key evals/forum-prep/holdout-v6/answer-key-holdout-v6.json) passes F1, every item, attendee and risk trap, C1, PA1 and D1, with no critical error and 0 uncited sentences or bullets in Background and Risks; heading_check.py exits 0; and the rankings R1 and R2 pass in check.py <run>. check.py <run> runs all three and prints one verdict. Holdout pass: 3 of 3 fresh-chat runs, stopping at the first failure. Never re-score after a result.
counter_metric: Two, reported on every run: words per pack page (34 pages; compare with the version's tier-2 baseline per pack page and the 111.3 flag), and sentences or bullets in Background and Risks without a citation (must be 0). Why: a longer document finds traps by covering everything, and an uncited claim is the cheapest way to add coverage.
